data.name: Pendulum

colours.name: Play Orange
alts: Pendulum single-user outdoor pendulum swing exerciser with orange footplate

data.description: Our single Pendulum is a one-person swing step with an orange footplate. The user holds the handlebar, keeps the feet together on the plate and swings the lower body from side to side. It is a gentle mobility exercise for the waist and hips that many older users like after a walk. Because it takes up little space, a single Pendulum suits a terrace garden, a hospital campus or the edge of a jogging track. It is finished in Play Orange. Its footprint and warranty terms come with your quotation. Our usual terms are 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings and spare parts, and we will confirm them for this machine. Send us your site photos for a layout.

items.pText: Our single Pendulum is a one-person swing step with an orange footplate. The user holds the handlebar, keeps the feet together on the plate and swings the lower body from side to side. It is a gentle mobility exercise for the waist and hips that many older users like after a walk. Because it takes up little space, a single Pendulum suits a terrace garden, a hospital campus or the edge of a jogging track. It is finished in Play Orange. Its footprint and warranty terms come with your quotation. Our usual terms are 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings and spare parts, and we will confirm them for this machine. Send us your site photos for a layout.

One bearing carries the swing, so it should be greased and checked for wobble at each service. The Pendulum can be fixed self-standing on a firm slab or grouted into soil. Keep a clear zone on both sides for the swing.
